title: Private Diamond Head Crater and Manoa Falls Rainforest Experience
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a private tour to two of the most breathtaking landscapes on Oʻahu. Enjoy stunning panoramic views over Waikīkī and the Pacific Ocean from Diamond Head State Monument, followed by a lush rainforest adventure to Mānoa Falls.

These are two completely different worlds—one a paved volcanic crater hike with sweeping coastal views, the other a tropical jungle trail leading to a beautiful waterfall. Perfect for capturing unforgettable photos with breathtaking backdrops of Waikīkī, the Pacific Ocean, and Oʻahu’s lush tropical rainforest.

You can experience both hikes in one day, or choose just one and use the remaining time to explore other areas of the island. Your guide will offer personalized suggestions, but the day is fully customized based on your interests, time, and energy level.

When booking, simply let us know if you’d like to do one hike or both.
